/# Log a message to a locally saved Text file.
A new log file is created for each execution day.#/
DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> CurrentDateTime
Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: CurrentDateTime CustomFormat: $'''dd.MM.yyyy''' Result=> FormattedDate
Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: CurrentDateTime CustomFormat: $'''HH:mm:ss''' Result=> FormattedTime
IF (File.IfFile.DoesNotExist File: $'''%Config['PathToLogFile'] + Config['ProcessName'] + '_' + FormattedDate%.txt''') THEN
    File.WriteText File: $'''%Config['PathToLogFile'] + Config['ProcessName'] + '_' + FormattedDate%.txt''' TextToWrite: FormattedTime + ' | ' + LogLevel + ' | ' + LogMessage AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.Unicode
ELSE
    IF LogMessage = $'''Worker started''' THEN
        File.WriteText File: $'''%Config['PathToLogFile'] + Config['ProcessName'] + '_' + FormattedDate%.txt''' TextToWrite: $'''
----------------------------------------------------
 
%FormattedTime + ' | ' + LogLevel + ' | ' + LogMessage%''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.Unicode
    ELSE
        File.WriteText File: $'''%Config['PathToLogFile'] + Config['ProcessName'] + '_' + FormattedDate%.txt''' TextToWrite: FormattedTime + ' | ' + LogLevel + ' | ' + LogMessage AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.Unicode
    END
END
